title: Hodge theory and $G_4$ fluxes in weighted projective spaces: Galois action
summary: We extend the explicit study of $G_4$-fluxes and general Hodge cycles from the ordinary Fermat sextic fourfold to tame Fermat-type hypersurfaces in weighted projective space. The main new feature in the weighted setting is that the Galois action on the cyclotomic period data need not preserve the $(2,2)$-subspace. As a consequence, the rational reconstruction of an integral self-dual class can involve additional middle-cohomology components, increasing the norm of the corresponding flux.
